homepage.deck.friend.tagline.message: One good question beats three hours of chit-chat.

homepage.deck.dating.tagline.message: Not sure what to say? Let a card speak first.

homepage.deck.partner.tagline.message: Not just the day. What's underneath it.

homepage.deck.household.tagline.message: Love is the easy part. Living together takes talking.

homepage.deck.colleague.tagline.message: Not just working together. Understanding each other.

homepage.deck.upward.tagline.message: Not just reporting. Knowing who leads you.

homepage.steps.pick.body.message: Choose the relationship that fits whoever is sitting across from you today.

homepage.steps.flip.body.message: Tap to turn a card over. Swipe left for the next one, right to go back. No repeats in a round — the deck reshuffles once you've been through it all.

homepage.steps.keep.body.message: Save a card you want to come back to, or write a note on it and tag who you talked with.

homepage.levels.light.question.message: What have you been obsessed with lately?

homepage.levels.deeper.question.message: What moment keeps replaying in your head?

homepage.levels.deep.question.message: What's something about you you wish I knew?

homepage.features.favorites.body.message: Tap the bookmark on a card you want to come back to, and start there next time.

homepage.features.notes.body.message: A card can hold several notes. Three people answer the same question, that's three notes, each tagged with who said it.

homepage.features.partners.body.message: Keep a list of the people you talk with. Each one's page gathers every note from your conversations.

homepage.features.review.body.message: A look back at the last 30 days: which relationships you talked about most, how deep you usually went, and who you haven't talked with in a while. It describes — it never scores.

homepage.features.streak.body.message: See how many days in a row you've talked, and look back on the calendar at which questions came up on which day.

homepage.features.reminder.body.message: Pick a time and a topic, get one question a day, and tap the notification to start talking.

homepage.hero.lead.message: RelationDeck holds 12 relationship decks and 360 questions that go from light to deep. Put the phone on the table, flip a card, take turns answering, and let the question get you started.

homepage.decks.title.message: Twelve decks for twelve relationships in your life

homepage.decks.lead.message: From yourself, friends and partners to family and work. Thirty cards each, from easy warm-ups to the question you'd never usually ask.

homepage.steps.lead.message: Nothing to prepare. Open it and start.

homepage.levels.title.message: Three levels, one step at a time

homepage.levels.lead.message: Every card is marked with its depth. Light questions come first, then Deeper and Deepest — you don't have to choose.

homepage.features.title.message: What you talked about stays with you

homepage.features.lead.message: Beyond drawing cards, the app keeps every conversation in order.

homepage.privacy.title.message: Your conversations stay on your phone

homepage.privacy.body.message: RelationDeck needs no account. Saved cards, notes and history are stored only on your device and are not uploaded to any server by default. Every card works offline, too.

homepage.newsletter.point.android.message: Be the first to know when the Android app launches

homepage.newsletter.point.articles.message: New articles and conversation topics in your inbox

homepage.newsletter.lead.message: Leave your email to get the latest from RelationDeck. (The newsletter is written in Traditional Chinese.)

homepage.download.lead.message: Download it for iPhone today — the app switches between English and Traditional Chinese. The Android version is coming soon to Google Play; newsletter subscribers will hear the day it launches.

homepage.meta.title.message: Draw a card. Start a real conversation.

homepage.meta.description.message: RelationDeck is a conversation card app. 12 relationship decks and 360 questions that go from light to deep help you have real conversations with friends, partners, parents, kids, siblings and colleagues. With notes, a look back at your conversations and a daily reminder — your data stays on your device by default.
